title: Nader Shah is crowned king of Persia
summary: At a great assembly on the Mughan plain, the general Nader was proclaimed Shah of Iran, ending the Safavid dynasty.
reason: Nader had driven out the Afghans, Ottomans and Russians, and was already the real ruler behind a child Safavid shah.
significance: He founded the Afsharid dynasty and briefly made Persia the strongest power in Asia west of China.
